text: No fire was detected on the asset (ASSET-F01) during the evaluated period (2026-09-23 to 2026-10-23). NASA FIRMS data showed zero thermal anomalies intersecting the property, with full sensor coverage (VIIRS and MODIS) throughout. However, small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected. This evidence does not confirm the absence of fire but indicates no significant thermal activity was recorded.
